_about: Which MetaHuman Creator preset each employee starts from, and what the Character Bible (Agents ID and Bible/CHARACTER_BIBLES.md) says they must look like. The preset is a starting face and body only: hair, skin and wardrobe are then set to the Bible. The preset choices are provisional (picked by the Bible's gender and age before the presets could be seen) and are to be confirmed from the rendered headshots.
